name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: A set of layered sections of content—known as tab panels—that are displayed one at a time.
usageSnippet: Content of the ${value} panel.

props.name: activationMode
props.description:
The activation mode of the tabs. Can be `manual` or `automatic`
- `manual`: Tabs are activated when clicked or press `enter` key.
- `automatic`: Tabs are activated when receiving focus

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial selected tab value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the selected tab value.

props.name: deselectable
props.description: Whether the active tab can be deselected when clicking on it.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the tabs. Useful for composition.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether the keyboard navigation will loop from last tab to first, and vice versa.

props.name: navigate
props.description:
Function to navigate to the selected tab when clicking on it.
Useful if tab triggers are anchor elements.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
The orientation of the tabs. Can be `horizontal` or `vertical`
- `horizontal`: only left and right arrow key navigation will work.
- `vertical`: only up and down arrow key navigation will work.

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

events.name: onFocusChange
events.description: Callback to be called when the focused tab changes

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Callback to be called when the selected/active tab changes

examples.title: Default
examples.source:
import Tabs from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tabs/tabs.marko"; static const ACCOUNT_TABS = [ { value: "account", label: "Account" }, { value: "password", label: "Password" }, ];

Make changes to your account here. Click save when you're done.

Change your password here. After saving, you'll be logged out.
examples.description: Pass `items` and branch on the body's parameter, each panel's own `value`; Zag shows the active panel.

examples.title: Line
examples.source:
import Tabs from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tabs/tabs.marko";

<Tabs variant="line" class="w-[400px]">
  <@trigger value="overview">Overview</@trigger>
  <@trigger value="analytics">Analytics</@trigger>
  <@trigger value="reports">Reports</@trigger>
  <@panel value="overview">Overview panel content.</@panel>
  <@panel value="analytics">Analytics panel content.</@panel>
  <@panel value="reports">Reports panel content.</@panel>
</Tabs>
examples.description: Pass `variant="line"` for an underline-style tab list.

<Tabs class="w-fit">

examples.title: RTL
examples.source:
import Tabs from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tabs/tabs.marko";
import Card from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/card/card.marko";
import CardHeader from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/card/header.marko";
import CardTitle from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/card/title.marko";
import CardDescription from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/card/description.marko";
import CardContent from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/card/content.marko";

<Tabs class="w-full max-w-sm" dir="rtl">
  <@trigger value="overview">نظرة عامة</@trigger>
  <@trigger value="analytics">التحليلات</@trigger>
  <@trigger value="reports">التقارير</@trigger>
  <@trigger value="settings">الإعدادات</@trigger>
  <@panel value="overview">
    <Card dir="rtl">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>نظرة عامة</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          عرض مقاييسك الرئيسية وأنشطة المشروع الأخيرة. تتبع التقدم عبر جميع مشاريعك النشطة.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent class="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
        لديك ١٢ مشروعًا نشطًا و٣ مهام معلقة.
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  </@panel>
  <@panel value="analytics">
    <Card dir="rtl">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>التحليلات</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          تتبع مقاييس الأداء ومشاركة المستخدمين. راقب الاتجاهات وحدد فرص النمو.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent class="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
        زادت مشاهدات الصفحة بنسبة ٢٥٪ مقارنة بالشهر الماضي.
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  </@panel>
  <@panel value="reports">
    <Card dir="rtl">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>التقارير</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          إنشاء وتنزيل تقاريرك التفصيلية. تصدير البيانات بتنسيقات متعددة للتحليل.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent class="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
        لديك ٥ تقارير جاهزة ومتاحة للتصدير.
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  </@panel>
  <@panel value="settings">
    <Card dir="rtl">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>الإعدادات</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          إدارة تفضيلات حسابك وخياراته. تخصيص تجربتك لتناسب احتياجاتك.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent class="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
        تكوين الإشعارات والأمان والسمات.
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  </@panel>
</Tabs>
examples.description: Tabs restyles correctly under `dir="rtl"` with no component changes.

examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`, or use Marko's bind shorthand `value:=state`.

examples.description: Use `<@trigger>` and `<@panel>` attribute tags instead of `items=` to compose each tab's label and panel content directly in markup.

examples.title: Precedence
examples.source:
import Tabs from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tabs/tabs.marko";

<Tabs items=[{ value: "ignored", label: "Ignored" }]>
  <@trigger value="wins">Wins</@trigger>
  <@panel value="wins">Attr panel wins</@panel>
</Tabs>
examples.description: When both `items=` and attribute tags are supplied, the attribute tags win — the `items=` entry here is replaced entirely.

examples.title: Hybrid
examples.description: `<@trigger>` and `<@panel>` normalize independently: mixing `<@trigger>` tags with `items=` (and no `<@panel>` tags) pairs attr-tag triggers with items=-derived panels. Supply both tag names (or neither) to stay on one source.

body.description:
The fallback panel content: for every panel without its own `<@panel>`
body, it is rendered once with THAT panel's `value` as its parameter
(`<Tabs|value|>…</Tabs>`), and Zag shows only the active panel, so branch
on the parameter to render each panel's content. It is not the currently
active value.

composition:
Tabs renders its own list/trigger/panel anatomy internally — there are no
separate TabsList/TabsTrigger/TabsContent tags to compose. Choose one of two
equivalent forms:

```text
Tabs (items=)
├── list
│   ├── item 1 { value, label, disabled? }
│   └── item 2 { value, label, disabled? }
└── content(value) — rendered once per panel, with that panel's value
```

```text
Tabs
├── <@trigger value>label</@trigger>
├── <@trigger value>label</@trigger>
├── <@panel value>content</@panel>
└── <@panel value>content</@panel>
```

`trigger` and `panel` normalize INDEPENDENTLY: attr tags win over `items=`
per tag name, not for the component as a whole. Mixing `<@trigger>` tags
with `items=` (and no `<@panel>` tags) pairs attr-tag-derived triggers with
items=-derived panels — see the Hybrid example below.
